title: Charles I and Nicholas to Sir William Boswell, 2 Nov 1643, TNA SP 84/157 ff. 217, 219

steps.what: Pitt's repository found with the alphabet; TNA references from Discovery; Simpson 1893 re-credentials letter and memorial, CSPD.
Pitt's row against 20,000 random rows over the same periodic structure: z = 9.6, 0 of 20,000 as good.
Free 24-letter row annealed for periods 20-32; over-fits at 106 letters, not decisive.
The four graphic signs are word-signs introduced inline: good, Cousin, Master, us.
Both letters read in connected text with word codes from context and alphabetical slots; transcription slips listed.
Addressee identified as the Duke of Courland's envoy from Simpson's re-credentials letter of the same day; arms shipment matches CSPD.

outcome.method_basis: Robert Pitt's alphabet, supplementary homophones, nulls and four word codes (GitHub charles-i-boswell-cipher, 14 Sept 2026) were on line before the attempt and applied to Tomokiyo's 2021 transcription; word codes were then filled from context.
outcome.notes: Read in substance; a dozen single-occurrence word codes open. Alphabet is Pitt's. NOTES say session 2026-09-16, git commit is 2026-09-15.

prior.where: R. Pitt, GitHub robertpitt/charles-i-boswell-cipher (commit 609ebf4, 14 Sept 2026): alphabet, supplementary homophones, nulls, four word codes
